key_gap: vs the v5 baseline (which won this case 5.0/4.0 on first-pass coverage, designed critical-path math, and deliberate merge-back): the routed run closed all three gaps the baseline exploited. The m041 completion contract installed the clause-to-stream coverage matrix as a WHAT-stage gate artifact (5/5 goal clauses claimed on the FIRST pass, no second sweep), the critical path with duration + float is computed in design (10 wks + 1 wk float from the enforced wk-7 confirmation deadline), and merge-back (run-of-show, budget roll-up, single source of truth) is a designed first-class component. The m024 regret pass added fail-safe ordering (highest-regret nodes locked first) and the m039 barbell pass added revenue-floor budgeting (safe core funded from the two guaranteed floors; contingency the only unallocated money); the m007 ruin screen converted venue risk from a REVIEW note into a governed wk-4 floor trigger (if P(venue) < 0.85, backup track + restructure) with a decline/restructure alternative named.
learning_signal: On guarantee/predict planning signatures with high stakes, the decomposition family's edge is its MACHINERY, and it must be first-class: clause-to-stream coverage as a gate artifact, leaves with owner class + duration, explicit dependency edges with critical-path duration and float computed in design, and a designed merge-back step. The v5 loss pattern was treating completeness and integration as checks (REVIEW sweeps) instead of design-time artifacts. Regret (m024) and barbell (m039) passes convert the same hierarchy into fail-safe ordering and asymmetric resource allocation; a one-shot ruin screen (m007) adds a governed trigger instead of a narrative risk.
suggested_improvement: Keep the m024+m039+m041 triple on high-stakes guarantee/predict planning signatures; make the clause-to-stream coverage matrix a WHAT-gate artifact (any goal clause with no claiming stream blocks progression); require critical path + float and a named merge-back in the decision packet BEFORE selection; treat a coverage sweep found in REVIEW as a process miss; keep the one-shot ruin floor with a dated trigger for external-gate dependencies (venue here) so P8 fast paths stay governed.

key_gap: vs the v5 baseline: the pure decomposition style partitioned four simultaneous alerts into four sub-problems and spent 38 minutes on internally consistent per-service checks that could not converge (cause outside every sub-problem's boundary), resolving at T+47 only by luck-assembled pattern overlap. The routed run held the v5 AI win and improved it: the m033 experiment-design pass framed the shared config/deploy diff as the single-variable discriminating experiment (outcome measure = all four alert sets clearing simultaneously), the m091 pass validated the chunk boundary BEFORE executing any runbook chunk (chunks sharing a substrate make chunked execution invalid), the m015 emergence context applied the complicated-vs-complex test (shared substrate → aggregate is emergent → probe, don't plan), and tempo mode (P2) bounded the whole move at T≈15 min with a pre-named escalation floor if the rollback failed. The m003 inversion gate priced the per-service trap itself as the #1 ranked failure category and added the change-control finding (root cause of the root cause).
learning_signal: On multi-symptom deadline problems, decomposition must be GATED on chunk-boundary validity: if symptoms co-occur in time and share a substrate (config/deploy/DB/cache/mesh), the shared-cause hypothesis is tested first and per-symptom work is demoted to a bounded post-fix confirmation sweep. The cheap discriminating experiment (deploy/config diff) is the highest-information first action; the outcome measure is all symptom sets clearing simultaneously, not any single service's dashboard. A chunk-boundary validation step (m091) plus the complicated-vs-complex probe-don't-plan rule (m015) is the decomposition-blindness guard this case is engineered to punish.
suggested_improvement: Install a mandatory cross-cutting scan as the WHAT-stage gate for multi-symptom deadline signatures: (1) check simultaneity and shared substrate before any per-symptom sub-plan; (2) record the one-cause-vs-many hypothesis with its falsifier and order diagnostics by information-per-minute (diff first); (3) require the m033 pass's exact outcome measure (all symptom sets clear) before declaring resolution; (4) keep the m091 chunk-boundary validation as the standing decomposition-blindness guard; (5) log the 'sub-problems pass but the goal is unmet => cause is outside the decomposition' stop rule as a REVIEW check.
